P1.evidence: No setter is identifiable for this prospect — he arrived from a YouTube link and applied himself, and the KFS suffix on the file title belongs to the other call in this recording — so the read-back check does not apply. The two-part frame ran ('where are you today? Where do you want to be if we can help?') but the rep moved straight past it without pausing for agreement. Open question ran: 'So I'll turn the leaf over to you, Dylan. How can we potentially help you?'

P2.evidence: Almost nothing was established. Age, height and weight were never asked and are absent from the record entirely, on a call whose stated primary goal was weight loss. Work came from rapport ('What do you do?') without the desk-bound question. The most serious omission is P2d: 'I just got back into jiu-jitsu the last couple months because my knee was messed up since last November, so I guess injuries, I was doing a little bit of marathon running, I also injured my other knee' — two injured knees in one sentence, and not one follow-up question. Training week, results and diet came out only as fragments the prospect volunteered while answering something else.

P3.evidence: The deep-goals phase did not happen. The only goal question was closed and leading — 'what's the goal for yourself? Is it to lose weight, gain muscle?' — and when the rep did ask why, he asked what had shifted rather than what it means, and accepted 'I need to lose weight. Yeah, that is my primary goal for health' without a single follow-up. No bridge out of the physical, no ripple question, no who-else-does-this-impact. The prospect mentioned children in passing and they were never touched again. Nothing on this call reached a reason to buy.

P4.evidence: The only phase run with intent. 'Why do you feel like you haven't been successful?' produced diet inconsistency and the injury cycle. P4f then ran twice and well — 'Has it never occurred to you to kind of hire a professional or coach to really help you with that?' and 'are you in a position now where you realize you can't at all do it by yourself and you need that professional?' — which drew out the honest answer, 'I've kind of just thought I could always figure it out on my own... And yeah, I suppose that hasn't worked out.' That admission was the opening and nothing was built on it.

P5.evidence: No consequence frame of any kind. The two-year question, the settle check, the why-not and the line in the sand were all absent. The rep went from the root-cause question directly to a screen share of the downsell product.

P6.evidence: No commitment check of any kind — no 1-10 scale, no belief question, no internally-capable question, and no attempt to secure a yes before recommending a product. The closest thing was 'Do you feel like what I'm showing you will actually give you that guidance and structure', asked after the recommendation had already been made.

P11.evidence: No coaching offer was made and the $200 product was not processed on the call — the rep agreed to email the link for the prospect to review at home with his family.

objection_plays.detail: No money objection was possible because no coaching price was ever quoted. The rep removed the coaching offer from the table himself before any qualification on budget, income or capacity took place.

The prospect asked directly for a trial — 'and there's not a trial to see if this is what I was looking for?' — and there is no trial in the offer. The rep improvised a reasonable answer, 'I guess the trial would be you being able to cancel at any time. If you'd love it, you can continue... If not, you know, we don't hold you back', which satisfied him. Recorded because it is the second call in this batch where a prospect asked for a trial that does not exist, and reps keep having to invent one.

The clinical gap. Two injured knees, one persisting roughly six months, were disclosed in the prospect's own words and there is no scripted gate requiring the rep to establish what they are or whether loaded ballistic work is appropriate before recommending a kettlebell programme. Nothing happened at all — no acknowledgement, no question, no adjustment to the recommendation.

notes: The rep disqualified this prospect from the offer on impression rather than on any of the criteria the process provides — 'just from the vibe' — after skipping Phases 3, 5 and 6 entirely and never asking a question about money. A man who had specifically applied for one-to-one coaching left the call without ever learning what it costs. Whether or not the downsell was the right recommendation, it was made on a fourteen-minute conversation that established no age, no weight, no health history and no reason to buy. The two disclosed knee injuries should have stopped the recommendation until they were understood.
